title: Star Meadow
description: Run, jump, and find your stars.
intro: The landscape and gravity are ready. Your first little job: make the Right arrow move your fox. Write it inside update(), where pass is now. Want a hint?
ideas: Help me add jumping to my platformer, one small step at a time.
How can I change my fox into a bunny?
Suggest two small variations I could make to this platformer. Let me choose.
guide: How far you move each moment.
The upward push at the start of a jump.
A rule that runs when you touch a star.
